purpose: Controlled authoritative-source supplement for Manual 08 source requirements not yet present in the shared registry. Shared and supplemental source IDs are validated together and duplicates fail closed.

sources.title: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0: Quick-Start Guide for Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (C-SCRM)

control_boundary: This supplement extends source coverage for Manual 08 only. It does not replace the shared authoritative-source registry and must fail closed if a supplemental source ID later duplicates a shared registry ID.
